reason: I run 9+ chairs and 15 staff, I don't switch my billing on the word of a one-man setup that is still looking for its first five salons. No owner I know is using this yet, so I'll wait and ask around in a few months.
objection: If this one person gets sick or gives up, my whole billing and customer list for a busy bridal season is stuck with a small app nobody else in Bhubaneswar uses. ₹500 a month also sounds too cheap to be serious for a salon my size.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running smoothly for a few months in another big salon whose owner I know, or my product distributor recommending it.
